title: Critical path drill (real faults to the fake Google Chat Critical space)
proves: On a local stack, a Postgres hang, a refused Redis and a probe at a dead port make the real Prometheus rules fire, the real Alertmanager route to the real chat-bridge, and one card per fingerprint appear in the Critical space of a fake Chat receiver with live evidence and a runbook; a warning-only condition posts nothing; nothing reaches Slow Queries or Deploy; each fault's end posts RESOLVED in the same thread; the resolver stays dry-run.
doesNotProve: Delivery to real Google Chat (never called), production thresholds and durations (for: is shortened to 20 s, group_interval to 15 s), the real webhook URLs or secrets, or anything on staging or production.
